q: The universal prediction (lossless) problem: given x₁,…,xₙ without knowing the source distribution, the best achievable per-symbol regret against the best compressor from a class 𝒞 scales as:
opts: O((|𝒞|log n)/n) for finite classes, O((k log n)/n) for k-parameter models (the minimax redundancy)
exp: For k-parameter source classes, the minimax redundancy per symbol is (k/2)(log n)/n + O(1/n) (Shtarkov, Rissanen). This is the best achievable rate of learning—any universal code pays at least this penalty in extra bits per symbol relative to the true entropy.
